xrefdescription.para: DKD-01: emit() with no listeners does not throw.
DKD-03: clearListeners() removes all registered listeners.
DKD-04: listenerCount() reflects add and clear operations.
DKD-05: A single registered listener receives the emitted event.
DKD-06: Multiple listeners all receive the same event.
DKD-07: A throwing listener does not prevent subsequent listeners from receiving the event.
DKD-08: timestamp_utc is populated automatically when left empty.
DKD-09: emitMergeTimeout fills type, shard_id, operation_id, cause.
DKD-10: emitDedupCollision populates fields and metadata.key.
DKD-11: emitTrustGateReject sets severity to ERROR.
DKD-12: emitPartialShardMerge populates responding/total shard metadata.

detaileddescription.para:
Verifies all four constraint scenarios:
Unconstrained policy (all zeros, BEST_EFFORT) → false
Constrained by max_merge_latency_ms → true
Constrained by dedup_window_size → true
Constrained by FAIL_CLOSED timeout_behavior → true
All tests are fully self-contained: no network I/O, no filesystem I/O. Diagnostic listeners are implemented inline as recording stubs.
